intro.zh: 青禾扎着高马尾，习惯用薄荷绿的笔记录香气。她最喜欢的词是「慢慢来」。
intro.en: Qinghe wears a high ponytail and records aromas in mint-green ink. Her favorite reminder is “Take your time.”

chapters.zh: 青禾给第一杯练习作品写下「雨后的木头」。她闻了闻笔帽，又补上一句：「也可能是刚削好的铅笔。」
chapters.en: Qinghe described her first practice cup as “Wood after rain.” After sniffing a pen cap, she added, “Possibly a freshly sharpened pencil.”

chapters.zh: 忙起来时，青禾的香气笔记只剩几个小圆圈。伙伴猜那是咖啡豆，她笑着说，那是提醒自己记得呼吸。
chapters.en: During a rush, Qinghe’s aroma notes became tiny circles. A teammate guessed coffee beans. She smiled: they were reminders to breathe.

chapters.zh: 青禾把新笔记本的第一页留给大家。最后上面写着「热面包」「干净围裙」和「有人替我接下一单」。她觉得第三种最好闻。
chapters.en: Qinghe left the first page of a new notebook for everyone: “Warm bread,” “Clean aprons,” and “Someone taking my next order.” The third smelled best to her.

intro.zh: 琥珀留着赤棕侧分短发，穿蜂蜜色工作衫。她把修好旧东西当作一种休息。
intro.en: Amber has auburn side-parted hair and a honey-colored work shirt. Mending old things is her favorite way to unwind.

chapters.zh: 琥珀发现休息室的抽屉会吱呀作响，随手记进修理本。她没有急着拆开它，先问清楚里面是谁珍藏的饼干。
chapters.en: Amber noted a squeaky break-room drawer in her repair book. Before taking it apart, she checked whose treasured biscuits were inside.

chapters.zh: 抽屉修好了，琥珀却把那枚旧木把手留下。她在背面写了日期，说旧东西也值得有一次毕业纪念。
chapters.en: The drawer was fixed, but Amber kept its old wooden handle. She dated the back: old things deserved a graduation keepsake too.

chapters.zh: 伙伴送来一个坏掉的小音乐盒。琥珀这次邀请大家一起拆，零件摆满桌面。修好后，她说最好听的是刚才大家一起屏住呼吸的那一秒。
chapters.en: A teammate brought a broken music box. Amber invited everyone to help. Once it played, she said the best sound had been their shared breath of anticipation.

intro.zh: 小满梳着双辫，喜欢玫瑰色围裙，也喜欢把平凡的小事认真庆祝一下。
intro.en: Xiaoman wears twin braids and a rose-colored apron. She likes finding small, ordinary things worth celebrating.

chapters.zh: 小满把第一次平稳送到桌边的托盘叫作「今日小胜利」。她没拍照，只在口袋的小纸条上画了一颗歪星星。
chapters.en: Xiaoman named her first steady tray delivery “Today’s Small Victory.” Instead of a photo, she drew a crooked star on a pocket-sized note.

chapters.zh: 小纸条上多了「记住同伴喜欢的茶」和「及时说了需要帮忙」。小满发现，值得庆祝的事不一定要做得漂亮。
chapters.en: Her notes gained “Remembered a teammate’s tea” and “Asked for help in time.” Xiaoman realized that something need not look impressive to be worth celebrating.

chapters.zh: 小满把满是星星的纸条折成信封，里面留了一张空白纸。她递给新伙伴：「今天的小胜利，轮到你来发现啦。」
chapters.en: Xiaoman folded her star-filled note into an envelope with a blank slip inside. She handed it to a new teammate: “Your turn to find today’s small victory.”

intro.zh: 冬青有蓬松的深色卷发，穿雾蓝工作衫。她记得住许多人的名字，也认真记得自己的休息时间。
intro.en: Holly has soft dark curls and a mist-blue work shirt. She remembers people’s names, and remembers to take her own breaks too.

chapters.zh: 冬青把一位客人的名字念错了，重新问了一遍，又轻轻重复。收工时她说，记住一个人，要从愿意听清楚开始。
chapters.en: Holly mispronounced a guest’s name, asked again, and repeated it gently. Remembering someone, she said afterward, starts with listening carefully.

chapters.zh: 冬青在休息时收到伙伴递来的水杯，才发现自己的习惯也被人记住了。她把杯子捧了好一会儿，说今天的水特别甜。
chapters.en: A teammate brought Holly water during her break. Realizing someone had remembered her habits too, she held the cup and said today’s water tasted especially sweet.

chapters.zh: 冬青不用再靠便签记大家的名字了。她把空下来的小夹板挂在休息室，写上「今天也有人记得你」。
chapters.en: Holly no longer needed notes for everyone’s names. She hung the spare clipboard in the break room and wrote, “Someone remembered you today, too.”

intro.zh: 栗子的暖棕肤色和栗色短发很配。他喜欢烤箱开门时的香气，也会给失败的面团起外号。
intro.en: Chestnut has warm brown skin and chestnut hair. He loves the scent of an opening oven and gives nicknames to dough that goes awry.

chapters.zh: 一块练习面团塌了，栗子给它起名「打盹的枕头」。他把原因记清楚，再认真揉起下一块。枕头没有成为借口。
chapters.en: A practice dough collapsed, so Chestnut named it “Napping Pillow.” He wrote down what went wrong, then kneaded another. The nickname was not an excuse.

chapters.zh: 栗子终于做出均匀的一盘，却先给伙伴看那张写满修改的纸。他说，香气是从这些小字里一点点长出来的。
chapters.en: After baking an even tray, Chestnut first showed his teammate a page of revisions. The lovely smell, he said, had grown a little at a time from those notes.

chapters.zh: 新伙伴问起那张「打盹的枕头」画像，栗子笑着翻出旧笔记。这次他没有急着示范，而是腾出位置，让对方自己试一试。
chapters.en: A new teammate asked about the “Napping Pillow” sketch. Chestnut found his old notes, then made room at the bench for them to try it themselves.

intro.zh: 白露把灰蓝头发收进厨师帽，喜欢淡紫工作服。她会把季节写成一句很短的诗。
intro.en: Bailu tucks slate-blue hair beneath her chef’s hat and favors lavender work clothes. She writes the seasons as tiny poems.

chapters.zh: 白露今天写的是「清晨，面粉落了一场小雪」。伙伴提醒她先擦台面，她于是添上后半句：「然后我们把冬天收好。」
chapters.en: Bailu wrote, “At dawn, the flour fell like snow.” Reminded to wipe the bench, she added, “Then we tidied winter away.”

chapters.zh: 忙了一天，白露只写下「大家都吃上了热的」。她原本想换个更漂亮的句子，读了两遍，决定就这样留下。
chapters.en: After a busy day, Bailu wrote only, “Everyone had something warm.” She considered a prettier sentence, read it twice, and kept it as it was.

chapters.zh: 白露把短诗订成小册，最后一页没有字，只有大家签的名字。她说，这一页读起来，最像咖啡馆的声音。
chapters.en: Bailu bound her poems into a booklet. Its final page held only everyone’s signatures. Read aloud, she said, that page sounded most like the café.

intro.zh: 林芽把咖啡香当作一天的天气预报，也喜欢给每次小进步画一片叶子。
intro.en: Lin reads the day’s forecast in the scent of coffee and draws a little leaf for every small step forward.

chapters.zh: 林芽在笔记本上画了第一片叶子，旁边写着「今天没那么紧张」。至于歪掉的叶柄，她决定说那是风吹的。
chapters.en: Lin drew her first leaf in a notebook and wrote, “A little less nervous today.” The crooked stem, she decided, was simply leaning in the wind.

chapters.zh: 笔记本上的叶子渐渐挤在一起，林芽开始记下同伴教她的小窍门。有一页看起来像棵灌木，她认真给它取名叫「大家的办法」。
chapters.en: As the leaves crowded together, Lin began adding little tips from her teammates. One page looked like a shrub, so she solemnly named it “Things Everyone Taught Me.”

chapters.zh: 林芽翻回第一页，发现那片歪叶子仍然最可爱。她在旁边留了一块空白，准备给未来还会紧张的自己画第二片。
chapters.en: Lin turned back to the first page and found that crooked leaf was still her favorite. She left a space beside it for the next time she felt nervous and kept going anyway.

intro.zh: 麦洛喜欢琢磨声音，从咖啡器具的轻响里也能听出一小段旋律。
intro.en: Milo loves noticing sounds and can hear a tiny melody in the gentle clatter of coffee tools.

chapters.zh: 麦洛悄悄给工作时听到的声音编了节拍，却总在最后一拍打喷嚏。他把这段曲子暂时命名为「差一点完成」。
chapters.en: Milo made a rhythm from the sounds of his work, then sneezed on the final beat. For now, the piece was called “Almost Finished.”

chapters.zh: 麦洛发现，同伴的脚步和笑声根本不肯按他的节拍来。他索性给曲子多留了几拍，觉得这样反而更好听。
chapters.en: Milo discovered that his teammates’ footsteps and laughter refused to follow his rhythm. He added a few extra beats and liked the tune better that way.

chapters.zh: 麦洛终于哼完了那段小曲，却没有把它写成乐谱。「每天都会有新的声音嘛。」他说完，又给结尾添了一声轻轻的笑。
chapters.en: Milo finally hummed the whole little tune, but decided against writing it down. “There’ll be new sounds tomorrow,” he said, adding a quiet laugh to the ending.

intro.zh: 米拉收集颜色的名字，坚信「暖棕色」至少还可以细分成十几种。
intro.en: Mira collects names for colors and firmly believes “warm brown” deserves at least a dozen more specific names.

chapters.zh: 米拉带来一本色彩小册，把今天的心情涂成「刚醒来的栗子」。同伴问她和普通栗子有什么不同，她说这一颗还想再睡五分钟。
chapters.en: Mira colored today’s mood “Sleepy Chestnut” in her little sketchbook. Asked how it differed from regular chestnut, she explained that this one wanted five more minutes in bed.

chapters.zh: 米拉开始请同伴为颜色取名字，结果收获了「围巾里的阳光」和「星期二的袜子」。她把两个名字都留下了，连拼写也没改。
chapters.en: Mira invited her teammates to name colors and received “Sunshine in a Scarf” and “Tuesday Socks.” She kept both names exactly as they were.

chapters.zh: 米拉画了一张没有标准色名的小色卡，每一格都藏着一句大家说过的话。她给整张色卡取名「在这里」，觉得这次不用再细分了。
chapters.en: Mira made a color card with no official color names, only little things people had said. She called the whole palette “Here” and felt it needed no further explanation.

intro.zh: 小月有点慢热，却很擅长发现别人没说出口的小需要。
intro.en: Yue takes a little time to warm up, but has a knack for noticing small needs before anyone mentions them.

chapters.zh: 小月在心里练习了好几遍问候，真正开口时却只说出一句轻轻的「你好」。对方也轻轻回了一句，她忽然觉得这样就很好。
chapters.en: Yue rehearsed a greeting several times, then managed only a soft “Hello.” The equally soft reply made her feel that perhaps this was plenty.

chapters.zh: 小月发现，记住一个小习惯，有时比准备一长串话更有用。她的小本子上开始出现奇怪的提醒，比如「先等别人把故事讲完」。
chapters.en: Yue found that remembering one small habit could be more useful than preparing a whole speech. Her notebook gained unusual reminders, such as “Let people finish their stories first.”

chapters.zh: 有位同伴忙得打结时，小月主动说了句「我陪你慢慢来」。说完她才发现，这句话已经不需要在心里练习了。
chapters.en: When a teammate got flustered, Yue offered, “We’ll take it one step at a time.” Only afterward did she realize she hadn’t needed to rehearse.

intro.zh: 阿栗总爱给平凡的小事起外号，口袋里仿佛装着用不完的好奇心。
intro.en: Ari gives everyday things playful nicknames and seems to carry an endless supply of curiosity.

chapters.zh: 阿栗把自己的工作清单叫作「今日小冒险」，第一项却只是「别把笔弄丢」。午后找到那支笔时，他郑重宣布冒险取得了阶段性胜利。
chapters.en: Ari titled his checklist “Today’s Little Adventure,” though its first item was simply “Don’t lose the pen.” Finding it later counted, he announced, as a significant victory.

chapters.zh: 阿栗发现，同伴们也开始用他的奇怪外号了。为了避免大家真的找不到东西，他在每个外号后面乖乖补上了本名。
chapters.en: Ari noticed his teammates had started using his odd nicknames too. To keep everyone from getting thoroughly lost, he carefully added the ordinary names beside them.

chapters.zh: 阿栗翻完旧清单，发现最开心的冒险几乎都写着「一起」。于是新清单只留了一个很大的空格，准备装下大家临时想到的好主意。
chapters.en: Looking through old lists, Ari found that his favorite adventures nearly always included the word “together.” His new list had one generous blank space for whatever good idea came next.

intro.zh: 诺亚喜欢地图和整齐的路线，不过他最珍惜的往往是绕路时遇见的小事。
intro.en: Noah likes maps and tidy routes, though his favorite discoveries tend to happen along the detours.

chapters.zh: 诺亚在纸上画了自己的工作路线，箭头整齐得像一排小鱼。实际走起来多绕了几步，他便给地图添了一条叫「没关系」的支线。
chapters.en: Noah sketched his work route with arrows as neat as a row of little fish. When the real route took a few extra steps, he added a branch labeled “That’s All Right.”

chapters.zh: 诺亚开始在地图上标注谁可能需要帮一把，路线很快变得弯弯绕绕。他盯着看了一会儿，觉得还挺像一条友善的河。
chapters.en: Noah began marking where a teammate might need a hand, and his tidy route grew winding. After studying it, he decided it looked like a rather friendly river.

chapters.zh: 诺亚把旧地图收好，今天没再急着画新的一张。他已经记住怎样走得顺，也记住了什么时候值得停下来。
chapters.en: Noah tucked away the old map without rushing to draw another. He had learned how to find his way, and when it was worth pausing along it.

intro.zh: 梅子做事细心，随身的小本子里既有工作心得，也有奶奶说过的俏皮话。
intro.en: Mei is thoughtful and precise, and her little notebook holds both practical notes and her grandmother’s playful sayings.

chapters.zh: 梅子在新一页写下奶奶的话：「着急的时候，先把肩膀放下来。」她试了一次，发现肩膀果然一直偷偷贴着耳朵。
chapters.en: Mei began a page with her grandmother’s advice: “When you’re rushing, lower your shoulders first.” Trying it, she discovered hers had been sneaking up toward her ears.

chapters.zh: 梅子开始在老话旁边添上自己的理解，有时还会画个小问号。她觉得奶奶要是看见了，大概会先夸问号画得圆。
chapters.en: Mei started adding her own thoughts beside the old sayings, sometimes with a small question mark. She suspected her grandmother would first compliment how round the question marks were.

chapters.zh: 梅子写下第一句完全属于自己的心得：「认真一点，也给自己留点余地。」她没有擦掉旁边的小墨点，反而给它画了两只耳朵。
chapters.en: Mei wrote her first entirely original saying: “Take care, and leave yourself a little room.” Rather than erase the ink blot beside it, she gave it two tiny ears.

intro.zh: 雨果看上去很沉稳，私下却会给工作用的小计时器打气。
intro.en: Hugo seems wonderfully composed, though he privately gives his little kitchen timer pep talks.

chapters.zh: 雨果被发现对计时器说「别紧张，我们来得及」。他想了想，承认这句话主要是说给自己听的。
chapters.en: Hugo was caught telling his timer, “Easy now, we’ve got time.” After a moment, he admitted the reassurance was mostly for himself.

chapters.zh: 雨果学会在事情挤到一起时，先清楚地说出需要什么帮助。计时器不用再独自听他讲话，显得格外安静。
chapters.en: Hugo learned to say clearly what help he needed when tasks piled up. No longer his only confidant, the timer seemed especially quiet.

chapters.zh: 雨果听见同伴也在给计时器打气，忍不住笑出了声。他还是会认真准备，只是现在更相信，忙碌可以由大家一起分担。
chapters.en: Hugo laughed when he heard a teammate encouraging the timer too. He still prepared carefully, but now trusted that a busy spell was something they could share.

intro.zh: 空喜欢折纸，也喜欢琢磨怎样让复杂的事情变成几个清楚的小步骤。
intro.en: Sora loves folding paper and finding a few clear little steps inside a complicated task.

chapters.zh: 空在休息时折了一只纸鸟，翅膀却一高一低。他把它摆正，说这是一只正在认真转弯的鸟。
chapters.en: On a break, Sora folded a paper bird with one wing higher than the other. Setting it upright, he explained that it was concentrating very hard on a turn.

chapters.zh: 空试着教同伴折纸，才发现自己省略了好几个「很明显」的步骤。他重新慢慢讲了一遍，也悄悄把自己的工作笔记写得更清楚了。
chapters.en: Teaching a teammate to fold paper, Sora realized he had skipped several “obvious” steps. He explained them slowly, then quietly made his own work notes clearer too.

chapters.zh: 空又折了一只纸鸟，这次翅膀很齐，却还是把它放在旧鸟旁边。两只鸟一起朝着前方，一只飞直线，一只负责看看沿途。
chapters.en: Sora folded another bird with neatly matched wings and placed it beside the first. They faced the same direction, one flying straight and the other taking in the scenery.
